<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SkillKoro Checkout</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  :root{
    --purple: #A436F1;
    --purple-dark: #7E1FD1;
    --purple-tint: #F6ECFE;
    --gold: #FFBF00;
    --ink: #1A1A2E;
    --ink-soft: #6B6B7B;
    --line: #E9E5F2;
    --bg: #FBF9FD;
    --white: #FFFFFF;
    --success: #17A673;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}

  body{
    font-family: 'Hind Siliguri', 'Nirmala UI', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    padding: 32px 16px 60px;
  }

  .wrap{
    max-width: 980px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .page-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .page-head h1{
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }

  .badge{
    background: var(--purple-tint);
    color: var(--purple-dark);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight:600;
    padding: 5px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 22px;
    align-items:stretch;
  }

  @media (max-width: 760px){
    .grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

    body{ padding: 20px 12px 40px; }

    .page-head h1{ font-size: 21px; }

    .card{ padding: 16px; }

    .full-width{ margin-top: 16px; }

    .card + .full-width{ margin-top: 16px; }

    .grid{ gap: 16px; }

    .course-row{ flex-wrap: wrap; }

    .thumb{ width: 84px; height: 52px; }

    .course-info{ min-width: 150px; }

    .course-info .name{ font-size: 13px; }

    .price-block{
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      margin-top: 8px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:baseline;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .pay-btn{
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 14px 20px;
    }

    .pay-methods-image img{ width: 88%; }

    .terms-check{
      text-align: left;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .terms-check label{ font-size: 12px; }

    .secure-note{ font-size: 11px; text-align:center; }
  }

  .card{
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,10,40,0.03);
  }

  .full-width{
    margin-top: 22px;
  }

  .card h2{
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  /* Customer Details */
  .field-row{ margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .field-row:last-child{ margin-bottom: 0; }

  .field-row label{
    display:block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .field-row input, .phone-row select{
    width:100%;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: #FCFBFE;
    border-radius: 9px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-family: inherit;
    color: var(--ink);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
  }

  .field-row input::placeholder{ color:#B3AEC2; }

  .field-row input:focus{
    border-color: var(--purple);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--purple-tint);
  }

  .phone-group input{ flex:1; }

  /* Order Summary */
  .course-row{
    display:flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items:flex-start;
  }

  .thumb{
    width: 104px;
    height: 60px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), #6B1FC2);
    flex-shrink:0;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    color:#fff;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size: 16px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }

  .thumb img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
  }

  .course-info{ flex:1; }

  .course-info .name{
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    line-height: 1.45;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .course-info .type{
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }

  .price-block{
    text-align:right;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }

  .price-now{
    font-weight:700;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .price-old{
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: #B3AEC2;
    text-decoration: line-through;
  }

  .coupon{
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--line);
  }

  .coupon-toggle{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    color: var(--purple);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor:pointer;
    user-select:none;
  }

  .coupon-toggle svg{ flex-shrink:0; }

  .coupon-input{
    display:none;
    margin-top: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .coupon-input.open{ display:flex; }

  .coupon-input input{
    flex:1;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    font-size:13.5px;
    font-family:inherit;
    outline:none;
  }
  .coupon-input input:focus{ border-color: var(--purple); }

  .coupon-input button{
    border:none;
    background: var(--purple);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    padding: 0 18px;
    border-radius:10px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: background .15s;
  }

  .coupon-input button:hover{
    background: var(--purple-dark);
  }

  .sum-lines{
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .sum-line{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .sum-line:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }

  .free-tag{
    color: var(--success);
    font-weight:600;
  }

  .sum-total{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .sum-total .label{
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight:700;
  }

  .sum-total .value{
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight:700;
    color: var(--purple-dark);
  }

  /* Payment methods badge image */
  .pay-methods-image{
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .pay-methods-image img{
    width: 50%;
    height: auto;
    display:block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }

  /* Terms */
  .terms-check{
    display:flex;
    gap: 9px;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    margin-top: 18px;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .terms-check input[type="checkbox"]{
    appearance:none;
    -webkit-appearance:none;
    width: 17px;
    height: 17px;
    flex-shrink:0;
    margin-top: 1px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 5px;
    cursor:pointer;
    position:relative;
    transition: background .15s, border-color .15s;
  }

  .terms-check input[type="checkbox"]:checked{
    background: var(--purple);
    border-color: var(--purple);
  }

  .terms-check input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    left: 5px;
    top: 1.5px;
    width: 4px;
    height: 8px;
    border: solid white;
    border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
    transform: rotate(45deg);
  }

  .terms-check label{
    cursor:pointer;
  }

  .terms-check a{
    color: var(--purple-dark);
    font-weight:400;
    text-decoration:none;
  }
  .terms-check a:hover{ text-decoration:underline; }

  /* Pay button */
  .pay-btn{
    position:relative;
    width: fit-content;
    min-width: 260px;
    margin: 22px auto 0;
    border: none;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--purple-dark));
    background-size: 160% 160%;
    background-position: 0% 50%;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 15.5px;
    font-weight:700;
    padding: 14px 120px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap: 10px;
    cursor:pointer;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(164,54,241,0.28);
    transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background-position .5s ease;
  }

  .pay-btn::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    top:0;
    left:-60%;
    width: 40%;
    height:100%;
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.35), transparent);
    transform: skewX(-20deg);
    transition: left .6s ease;
  }

  .pay-btn:hover{
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(164,54,241,0.4);
    background-position: 100% 50%;
  }

  .pay-btn:hover::before{
    left: 130%;
  }

  .pay-btn:active{
    transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(164,54,241,0.3);
  }

  .pay-btn svg{
    transition: transform .18s ease;
  }

  .pay-btn:hover svg{
    transform: translateX(3px);
  }

  .secure-note{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="wrap">

  <div class="page-head">
    <h1>Checkout</h1>
    <span class="badge">COURSE</span>
  </div>

  <div class="grid">

    <!-- LEFT: Customer Details -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>Customer Details</h2>

      <div class="field-row">
        <label>Full Name</label>
        <input type="text" placeholder="আপনার পুরো নাম লিখুন">
      </div>

      <div class="field-row">
        <label>Mobile Number</label>
        <div class="phone-group">
          <input type="text" placeholder="মোবাইল নম্বর">
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="field-row">
        <label>Email</label>
        <input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com">
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- RIGHT: Order Summary -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>Order Summary</h2>

      <div class="course-row">
        <div class="thumb">SK</div>
        <div class="course-info">
          <div class="name">২১ দিনের বাংলা এবং ইংলিশ কি-বোর্ড টাইপিং ম্যাজিক কোর্স</div>
          <div class="type">Recorded Course</div>
        </div>
        <div class="price-block">
          <div class="price-now">৳1,990</div>
          <div class="price-old">৳3,990</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="coupon">
        <div class="coupon-toggle" onclick="toggleCoupon()">
          <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M20.59 13.41L11 3.83A2 2 0 009.59 3.24H4a1 1 0 00-1 1v5.59a2 2 0 00.59 1.41l9.59 9.59a2 2 0 002.82 0l5.59-5.59a2 2 0 000-2.83z" stroke="#A436F1" stroke-width="1.6"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="1.2" fill="#A436F1"/></svg>
          Have a coupon code?
        </div>
        <div class="coupon-input" id="couponInput">
          <input type="text" placeholder="কুপন কোড লিখুন">
          <button>Apply</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sum-lines">
        <div class="sum-line"><span>Subtotal</span><span>৳1,990</span></div>
        <div class="sum-line"><span>Delivery Charge</span><span class="free-tag">FREE</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="sum-total">
        <span class="label">Total to Pay</span>
        <span class="value">৳1,990</span>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- FULL WIDTH: Select Payment Method -->
  <div class="card full-width">
    <h2>Payment Method</h2>
    <div class="pay-methods-image">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Supported payment methods - Visa, Mastercard, American Express, bKash, Nagad, Rocket and more">
    </div
>

    <div class="terms-check">
      <input type="checkbox" id="acceptTerms" checked>
      <label for="acceptTerms">
        By clicking "Place Order", I accept SkillKoro's
        <a href="#">Terms &amp; Conditions</a>, <a href="#">Privacy Policy</a> &amp; <a href="#">Refund Policy</a>*
      </label>
    </div>

    <button class="pay-btn">
      Pay ৳1,990
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
    </button>

    <div class="secure-note">
      <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2" stroke="#6B6B7B" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 018 0v4" stroke="#6B6B7B" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>
      100% Secure Payment via PayStation
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  function toggleCoupon(){
    document.getElementById('couponInput').classList.toggle('open');
  }
</script>

</body>
</html>
